messages:
Ana Liao: Hey team — first-day question. I'm Ana (platform eng). Trying to list instances in project redwood-eu-staging-2 via GCP console and `gcloud` but I get 'Permission denied' (403). Also need AWS read-only access to the billing account 0123-ABCD-4567 to check some cost allocations. Who should I ping for IAM + billing access? Thanks!
James Park: Welcome Ana! :wave: Ping cloud-infra or @Alex Chen for GCP. That 403 usually means you're missing roles/compute.viewer or roles/viewer on the project. For billing in AWS you'll need billing.accountViewer (or membership in rw-aws-billing-readers). Can you paste the project id and billing acct id?
Ana Liao: Project id: redwood-eu-staging-2. Billing id: 0123-ABCD-4567. I ran `gcloud compute instances list --project=redwood-eu-staging-2` and got the 403.
Alex Chen: Thanks — confirmed that's IAM. Please open an access request (audit trail) at https://go/redwood/access-requests -> choose 'Cloud IAM', include project ids, exact roles, justification, and TTL. I can provision a 30d temporary grant if needed. Note: GCP region permissions are not separate IAM objects — resource-level IAM controls access to resources in eu-west regions.
Maria Gomez: hi Ana, quick check: are you in the Okta group `engineering-platform`? Baseline GCP project viewer rights come from that group. If not, @it-ops can add you.
IT-Bot: New ticket created: #INC-2026-7890 assigned to cloud-infra. ETA ~8h. Reply with 'urgent' to escalate.
Ana Liao: Thanks — I just filed the access request with the link and included the project + billing acct + reason (needs to run initial infra smoke checks and cost queries). Small follow-up: I might need BigQuery read access for the billing export dataset — do I request that separately?
Kate Moran: For billing export datasets we grant roles/bigquery.dataViewer at the dataset level (we avoid project-wide grants). Tag finance on the ticket and we'll approve dataset access.
Alex Chen: I went ahead and granted roles/viewer on redwood-eu-staging-2 for Ana to unblock instance listing. For AWS billing, the flow is Okta group `rw-aws-billing-readers` -> AWS SSO mapping to BillingReadOnly. @it-ops I left a note to add Ana to that group.
Ana Liao: Verified — GCP console now lists the instances. AWS billing access still pending, will wait for Okta group add. Thanks everyone! :tada:
IT-Bot: Okta: user added to group `rw-aws-billing-readers`. AWS SSO mapping triggered; expect AWS-side access in ~30 minutes.
